citation.authors: Lawrence JA, Davis BA, Corbette T, Hill EV et al
citation.journal: Journal of Racial and Ethnic Health Disparities

record.population: Burnout in racial and ethnic minority groups
record.design: Systematic review of 16 studies, nearly all cross-sectional and North American, mostly medical students and physicians using the Maslach Burnout Inventory
record.finding: Differences in burnout between underrepresented minority and other groups were inconclusive, though several studies had nuanced findings. The authors call for better measurement and mitigation among underrepresented groups.
record.note: Doctors and medical students, not a general Black population; cross-sectional.
